Hand-drawn varying dark brown ink lines, quiet cream/pastel backgrounds, muted flat watercolor-like fills, warm slice-of-life comic feel, clear Korean handmade lettering just like reference. NOT glossy/3D, no detailed fur, no human bodies, no extra characters. BORI = female blue-gray chinchilla, wide face, enormous round pink-lined ears, mustard neck scarf. SUJIN = female warm taupe chinchilla, narrower face/smaller closer round ears, lavender scarf. MISO = female light peach chinchilla wide short face, outward round ears, no accessories. All male extras are raccoons, all female extras chinchillas. Keep these identities exactly; distinguish expressions via brows, eyelids, mouths, ears and posture with restraint. In chat panels, each message shows a tiny avatar and the correct name so no attribution ambiguity; use cream/pale yellow for Bori, pale lavender for Sujin, pale peach for Miso. Bottom small neat text "한술툰 · 창작 사연". Simple soft living room sofa and wooden table. Composition similar polished warmth to prior cover but fresh pose, large readable face. No literal phone UI tiny unreadable words.
